The '''Bestine system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="eao">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It contained [[Kestic Station/Legends|Kestic Station]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Bestine (star)|Bestine]].

==History==
The Bestine [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] and [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Lark_massacre.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The massacre of the ''[[Lark]]''{{'s}} passengers.]]

It was also the site where pilots [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic/Legends|mutiny]] on the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> These defections followed the destruction in the system of the civilian [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Lark]]'' and the massacre of his young passengers from the [[Clarion Scholars Academy]] shortly before.<ref name="Darklighter">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter]]''</ref>

During the Alliance to Restore the Republic's [[Operation Skyhook|investigation]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], and while [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]], the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] was [[Attack on the Defiance|engaged]] by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'', which launched squadrons of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to destroy her. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were able to tarry them, until the ''Defiance'' [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] away. The [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] was later [[Attack on the Independence|attacked]] in a similar way.<ref name="Xwing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
